sections.label: 🚀 Feature
items: Event page: the setlist as tables, after the relationship tables. "Setlist: Line-up" lists every artist with how they are joined ("&", "with", "and") and a Billing number that moves on at every joining word but "&"; then one table per part of the setlist ("Setlist: Soundcheck", "Setlist: Concert", …; "Setlist: Songs" when there are no parts), each part's notes ("Scheduled: 19:30 | …") under its heading. A medley line stays one row listing every work; "Also in" names the other parts that play the same work; "Recording" links the recording made at this event whose title is the line; a song without a work link is kept as text. Two new settings: "Setlist as tables" (on) and "One table for the whole setlist" (off: every song in "Setlist: All songs" with a Part column). The button is offered while either table part is on.

sections.label: 🔧 Refactor
items: Save to Disk stores, and Load from Disk restores, the paragraphs shown between a group's heading and its table (group.introHtml) — a part's setlist notes here, and the privileged-accounts page's intro text, which a disk load used to drop.

sections.label: 📝 Docs
items: New spec event-overview-setlist.spec.js (8 tests); event-overview.spec.js seeds the setlist off and covers the button with only the setlist on. scripts/mutations/event-overview.json grows to 32 planted defects, all caught. Snapshot baseline tests/snapshots/event-overview/ (event art seeded off) and its registry row.

sections.label: 🚀 Feature
items: New page type: the event page (musicbrainz.org/event/<mbid>) gains "Show all Relationships for Event". MusicBrainz lists an event's relationships as short lists, one target per line; they become filterable, sortable tables — one per kind of related entity (Artists, Places, Recordings, Releases, Series, URLs, …), each with the columns that fit it: the native link, a # column that restores the original order, the Relationship phrase, and — only when some row has one — Credits ("time: 19:40 - 22:29, lead vocals, harmonica"), Artist (a recording's or release's artist credit), Area (a place's), Details and Disambiguation; URLs get a Site column and keep their [info] link. The related series' own relationships (listed by MusicBrainz under "Related series": its tour artists, parent series and links) get their own "Via <series>" table.

Every part is a setting, in a new ⚙️ Settings group 🎫 EVENT PAGE: the page as a whole, "Relationships as tables", "One table for all relationships" (off by default: one table with Type and From columns instead of one per kind) and "Include the related series' own relationships" (off: that section stays as MusicBrainz shows it).

sections.label: 🔧 Refactor
items: A multi-table group may carry its own column list (group.colHeaders, from the table's data-mb-col-headers) for any page type, not only the ratings pages; Save to Disk now stores it and Load from Disk restores it, so after a disk load every group keeps its own header row instead of the first group's.

sections.label: 📝 Docs
items: New fixture tests/fixtures/event-overview.html (a raw capture of event 3f2ca30a-…, 2026-10-06) and spec event-overview.spec.js (7 tests: groups and aligned columns, the parts of a line, one table, related series on/off, filter and sort, Save/Load round trip, settings off).
